description: Change or COMPLETE a SimplifyQA sprint. Read sprints with sqa_query (collection "sprints"). Pass `sprintId` (id, code, or exact name) and either `close:true` (sets the completed state and the actual end date) or `state`, and/or name, dates, description, estimatedEffort, ownerIds. It reads the sprint back and reports the stored state. Only an admin user can edit a sprint in SimplifyQA, and its editor refuses to complete a sprint that still has new / pending stories, tasks or defects (not checked here).

close.description: true = close it: the project's completed-type state (Completed / Released / Closed) and the actual end date. Use this for "close release RE-44".

ownerIds.description: Owner user ids (replaces the current owners).

plannedEndDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

sprintId.description: Sprint id, code or exact name.

state.description: The state to set, as the project names it (e.g. "In-progress", "Completed"). An unknown state is refused with the valid ones listed.

name: sprint_update
title: Update or complete a sprint (SimplifyQA)
